correctness.rationale: For smooth nonhyperelliptic genus-three curves over an algebraically closed field of characteristic not 2, the 28 odd theta characteristics are q(v)=1 in F2^6; syzygetic tetrads are exactly distinct XOR-zero four-subsets. Independent enumeration yields precisely 315 tetrads; every incidence column obeys total coefficient ≡0 mod4 and vector sum=0 mod2. The augmented binary rank 7 establishes surjectivity to Z/4+(Z/2)^6 (correct total lift by 2e_v). A specifically selected 28×28 submatrix has exact integer determinant -256 in independent SymPy computation, so the generated lattice has index ≤256 and hence equals the congruence kernel of index 256. It has Smith factors 1^21,2^6,4. The finite enumeration is of the complete incidence system; the infinite integer-lattice equality follows by the index sandwich, not bounded coefficients.
